<!-- generated by scripts/sync.sh from contract.json; edit the factory, not this file -->

| Script | Contract |
| --- | --- |
| `bootstrap.sh` | install deps and local services; run by hand in a cloud session or a fresh clone; idempotent |
| `format.sh [files...]` | format the given files (all when none); never fails on unformatted input |
| `test.sh [filter]` | fast tests for iteration |
| `gate.sh` | the full local gate; exit 0 means shippable; never approves snapshots |
| `smoke.sh [url]` | check the deployed target; no argument means the target `deploy.yml` deploys to |
| `rollback.sh [release]` | the argument is the release to RESTORE (default: the one live before the current); prints what it will do first; refuses from cloud when the project cannot roll back from there |

A step that must not run in a cloud session refuses inside the script with
the command to run on the Mac. Scripts print no secrets.

A project that needs more than a usage line declares it in `AGENTS.md`
under `## Contract extensions`; the skills and the doctor read that heading.
